scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix clients
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix clients --include=dev && npm --prefix clients run build
scripts.start:dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
